english.note: Use this when the emphasis is on doing something quietly and without drawing attention.
Use this when the emphasis is on being quiet and making little noise or motion.

examples.english: I left placidly without drawing attention to myself.
examples.traditional: 我靜靜咁離開，冇驚動到人。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 zing6 zing2 gam3 lei4 hoi1 mou5 ging1 dung6 dou3 jan4

examples.english: Gently sit there quietly and wait for me without making a sound.
examples.traditional: 你靜靜咁坐喺度等我，唔好出聲。
examples.jyutping: nei5 zing6 zing2 gam3 co5 hai2 dou6 dang2 ngo5 m4 hou2 ceot1 seng1
